timeline.summary: Samiks dies, giving Zaraya a Nova Pentacle.
timeline.quote: In his dying breath, Samiks gifts his last relic to Zaraya.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering

timeline.summary: Freyalise, disguised, convinces Zaraya to hand over the Nova Pentacle and prophesizes Jaeuhl as champion.
timeline.quote: Prophesizing that Jaeuhl will be the champion in the final battle

timeline.quote: Both are now able to successfully teleport away.

timeline.summary: Towser and Karli summon nine defeated wizards to the tropical island; Towser has stolen and copied the Nova Pentacle and reveals his Keldon warlord.
timeline.quote: Towser reveals that he has stolen Greensleeves' Nova Pentacle and copied it.
